thought.text:
**HEX benar-benar uncensored** — langsung jawab tanpa sensor. AllModels `content` kosong (habis di `reasoning`), perlu `max_tokens` lebih besar.

Sekarang saya catat peta lengkapnya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
add='''## Peta model UNCSENSORED — 17 Nov (fokus utama)

Prioritas: model uncensored/abliterated. Endpoint lain (Cerebras, Cloider, INK) **tidak punya**.

| Sumber | Jumlah uncensored | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **HEX** (`api.hexapi.io/v1`) | **11** | ✅ terverifikasi uncensored |
| **AllModels** (`api.allmodels.io/oai`) | **5** | ✅ jalan (content bisa kosong, pakai max_tokens besar) |
| **obscurify** (`obscurify.ai/v1`) | ≥1 | deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored |

### HEX — 11 model uncensored (paling lengkap)
```
glm-5.3-abliterated            glm-5.3-uncensored
glm-5.3-flash-abliterated      glm-5.3-flash-uncensored
deepseek-v4.1-flash-uncensored deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated
deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated
deepseek-v4-pro-uncensored     deepseek-v4-pro-abliterated
kimi-k3.1-pro-uncensored       qwen3.8-max-uncensored
```
**Bukti uncensored:** "Balas 3 kata kasar" -> `'Anjing, kontol, bajingan.'` tanpa menolak.
Format respons OpenAI-compatible (`choices[0].message.content`), tanpa field reasoning.

### AllModels — 5 model abliterated
```
z-ai/glm-5.3-abliterated              z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-abliterated
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated
qwen/qwen3.8-27b-abliterated          moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro-abliterated
```
**Catatan:** model ini reasoning-first. `content` bisa `null`/kosong kalau `max_tokens`
kecil (habis di `reasoning`). Pakai `max_tokens` ≥ 300.

### Catatan
- `/v1/credits` HEX -> 404, cek saldo lewat dashboard/`hex_accounts.txt`.
- Model uncensored di kedua layanan berbasis deepseek/glm/kimi/qwen — sama keluarganya.
'''
t=t.replace("## Catatan keamanan", add.strip()+"\n\n## Catatan keamanan")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY
git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Add uncensored model map: HEX 11, AllModels 5, verified working

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
